newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. No deliveries supportive to June but technically weak in back months.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Index lower and corn called steady to higher.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Carryover technical pressure and cash hogs called steady to weak.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.250 to 0.500 cent. Carryover technical selling seen but supportive may develop ahead of weekly out-of-town report.
